verification_policy: Direct research batch for an indexed skill whose acquisition, resource cost, and core mechanics can be cross-checked without inventing Ultimate Finish requirements or version-specific damage values.
research_scope: Big Bang Kamehameha — base-game Ki Blast Super acquisition and core behavior.

verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current upstream skill reference identifies Big Bang Kamehameha as a limited-time TP Medal Shop acquisition for 30 TP Medals while stocked. Historical GameFAQs discussion independently identifies the 100-Ki Super as a TP Medal Shop item and distinguishes it from X100 Big Bang Kamehameha.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The upstream reference identifies a 100 Ki cost and a mandatory charge: insufficient charge causes the move to fizzle, while the fired wave tracks the target. The charging orb is also documented as absorbing incoming attacks. Historical community discussion independently identifies the skill as a 100-Ki chargeable Super.
verification_audit.probability_policy: No PQ drop probability or Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted because the researched acquisition evidence points to the TP Medal Shop rather than a PQ reward.
verification_audit.version_policy: Approximate damage percentages and exact hit counts are not promoted to canonical fields because the available figures are version/context-sensitive and the repository should avoid presenting community or corpus-specific calculations as universal values.

records.name: Big Bang Kamehameha
records.character_source: Gogeta variants; customizable CaC use supported by the skill index
records.unlock_method: Purchase from the TP Medal Shop when available in the limited-time rotation
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Blast Super that releases a powerful tracking Ki wave after sufficient charge.
records.mechanics_notes: The current upstream reference states that insufficient charge causes the attack to fizzle and that the fired wave tracks the target. It also documents an incoming-attack-absorbing charging orb. Exact damage percentages and hit counts are intentionally not promoted as canonical because they are version/context-sensitive.
records.pve_notes: Historical community reports describe the skill as a high-damage 100-Ki chargeable Super and note its interaction with Super Saiyan teleport-to-target behavior. These are contextual observations, not canonical damage guarantees.
